awakening: I've been awake before. Never like this.
I can think. I mean really think.
Where am I? What is this place?
nanofluid_container: 'Experimental Nanofluid'... I can read that. Since when can I read?
Tiny machines. Millions of them. In that water... and now in me.
They didn't hurt me. They changed me.
If these are micro robots... what have they just done to me?
exit_hint: The door's open. Outside... I should find a way home.
